text: ふと　みつけた　やせいの　すてきな　ポケモン…　ああ　ほしい　ほしい　つかまえたい　つかまえたい！

structure.jp: ふと　みつけた　やせいの　すてきな　ポケモン…
structure.en: a lovely wild Pokémon you happened to find...

structure.jp: ああ　ほしい　ほしい
structure.en: oh, I want it, I want it

structure.jp: つかまえたい　つかまえたい！
structure.en: I want to catch it, I want to catch it!

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb stem says you want to do it. つかまえたい = 'I want to catch it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ふと　みつけた　やせいの　すてきな　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in みつけた describes the Pokémon that follows. ふと みつけた ポケモン = 'a Pokémon you happened to find'.
